display_information.name: Appreciation Bot
display_information.description: Peer-to-peer recognition aligned with your company values. Give points, track progress, and redeem rewards.
display_information.long_description:
Appreciation Bot helps teams build a culture of recognition by enabling peer-to-peer appreciation aligned with company values.

Key Features:
• Give recognition with @mentions and ++ syntax directly in channels
• Track points by company value (teamwork, innovation, etc.)
• Configure custom rewards for point redemption
• Admin dashboard with daily limits and value management
• Optional GIF celebrations for high-point recognitions
• Leaderboard and personal stats on the Home tab

Perfect for remote and hybrid teams looking to boost morale and reinforce company culture.

slash_commands.description: Manage recognition points, config, and rewards
